lines.cap: She's been on top for nineteen hundred years, and never needed any support.
lines.say: She's been on top for nineteen hundred years, and never needed any support.

lines.cap: The dome of the Pantheon, in Rome. Finished around 125 AD.
lines.say: The dome of the Pantheon, in Rome. Finished around 125 AD.

lines.cap: It's forty three metres wide. Still the biggest dome ever built from concrete with no steel inside.
lines.say: It's forty three metres wide. Still the biggest dome ever built from concrete with no steel inside.

lines.cap: The secret? The concrete gets lighter as it goes up. Heavy stone at the bottom, light volcanic rock at the top.
lines.say: The secret? The concrete gets lighter as it goes up. Heavy stone at the bottom, light volcanic rock at the top.

lines.cap: Those square holes inside cut even more weight.
lines.say: Those square holes inside cut even more weight.

lines.cap: And there's a giant open hole at the top, eight metres wide. When it rains, it rains inside.
lines.say: And there's a giant open hole at the top, eight metres wide. When it rains, it rains inside.

lines.cap: Most modern concrete has steel inside, and steel rusts and cracks it over time.
lines.say: Most modern concrete has steel inside, and steel rusts and cracks it over time.

lines.cap: So she's still on top. And she's not coming down.
lines.say: So she's still on top. And she's not coming down.
